Change of design; the Task brief is rewritten, read it again. Jack Heart: "still think thats worth doing. change course!" Smoke is no longer a separate top-level `smoke()` hook. It is a tiny mode of each entry point, run in order by `etude smoke FILE` and by `etude launch` before it spends anything: each training job in its declared tiny form (one tiny update, a real checkpoint), then `eval(state)` with one game per matchup on those checkpoints, then `report()`. Remove any `smoke()` hook already written instead of keeping both. Shipping is on hold: stop at the design review.
